title: Grand Theft Chog
description:
Rob a rival gang's vault while its members jump in live and steer the guards against you, then run the bag home through a city full of real holders.

Grand Theft Chog is a live city at night where every Chog Genesis holder walks the streets as their own Chog, at the same time. Your Chog's traits decide which gang it can rep (20 gangs, each with its own building, vault, walk and lock), and gangs rob each other's vaults.

A robbery has three stages:

1. Break in. Every gang's door has its own lock: pick the pins, cut the alarm wires in order, stop the slot reels on the gang's building, or turn the safe dial. Slip more than once and the alarm goes off.
2. The vault. Grab the cash and crack the safe while the gang's guards hunt you. The guards are that gang's own Chogs. Your Chog's traits are its powers: laser eyes, the cardboard box, a blink, a coin toss to distract the guards and more.
3. The run home. Out of the vault with the bag, you have to carry it through the live city to your own gang's door, with police on foot and siren cars after you, while everyone online watches. Members of the gang you robbed can run you down themselves.

Get home and the cash lands in your gang's vault. Get caught and it goes back, your gang pays a fine, and your Chog sits in the city jail, where a gang-mate can break you out.

What makes it new:

- Every holder is in one city at once. Raids are live: the robbed gang can jump into its own vault and steer a guard against you, and anyone can watch.
- The record belongs to the NFT token. Cash stolen, escapes, busts and catches stay with the Chog when it's sold.
- Every robbery has a replay, from the break-in to the run home, made from the moves the server checked. Share the link and anyone can watch it.
- $CHOG is burned from your own wallet for bail (30), a Wanted poster on a rival (60: an extra officer on its getaways and a bounty on it) and a gang banner over your building (150). The plaza's big screen counts every $CHOG burned.
- The Chog Telegram bot posts the biggest robberies and a daily recap ("Yesterday in Grand Theft Chog") to the community.
- Judging week has events: a Left trait vs Right trait chogs election (24–26 Oct) where every bag carried home scores for your Chog's Side trait, and Halloween week (27–31 Oct) when the city is haunted, Skulls and Radioactive take more, and every haul counts double on the 31st.
- It works great on both phone and PC: a thumb stick, big buttons and a map you can pinch on a phone, and the keyboard on a PC.

Why the Chog NFT is essential:

Take the NFT out and there's no game. Your Chog is your character: its picture is the piece you move and the face everyone sees. Its traits pick its gang, its walk and its powers. The guards in a gang's vault are that gang's Chogs. The record is kept on the token, so it moves with the Chog when it changes hands. Ownership is read from the Chog Genesis contract and followed live, so a Chog sold walks out of your wallet and into the buyer's with all its records.

How it stays fair: the vault plays the same way every time from each run's seed, your phone sends only your key presses, and the server replays them to find what really happened. The run home is refereed by the live server, which signs the result. $CHOG burns are read from Monad and counted once. More: https://grandtheftchog.duckdns.org/fair
author: @anubisegx
tech_stack: Next.js 16, React, TypeScript, canvas 2D, WebSocket live server (Node), Postgres + Drizzle, viem + WalletConnect on Monad, Telegram bot, Caddy on a single VM
gtm_plan:
USAGE SO FAR (from the game's own records, Season 1 started 16 Oct)
- 7 Chog holders played, with 10 different Chogs
- 460+ guests played without a wallet
- 75 robberies (47 by players other than me), and 7 jail break-outs
- 4 raids had a live defender: a member of the robbed gang jumped in and steered a guard against the robber
- 19 Chogs joined 12 different gangs
- 5 of the 7 holders came back and played on another day. All of it can be verified.

Where it goes next

1. Monthly seasons
Every month the gang vaults reset and a new season starts. The richest gang, the top robber and the best guard of the season get their title written onto their Chogs for good. A Chog that won Season 1 still carries it when it's sold.

2. Crew heists
Two to four Chogs from the same gang rob one vault together: one cracks the lock, one goes for the safe, one runs the bag home. The biggest vaults only open to crews, so gangs have a reason to organise and play at the same time.

3. Vault upgrades paid in $CHOG
Gangs burn $CHOG to upgrade their vault: more guards, harder locks, police that show up faster. Every upgrade is a burn, so more play means less $CHOG in supply.

4. Raid alerts on your phone
An installable app for iPhone and Android that pings you when your gang's vault is being robbed, so you can jump in and defend it live. This is what brings people back every day.

5. Chog records on Monad
Season titles and each Chog's career (cash stolen, escapes, catches) get written to a contract on Monad, so marketplaces, bots and other games can show a Chog's history.

6. Events every month
Halloween week goes live on 27 Oct. A winter heist comes in December, plus more gang-vs-gang events like the Left vs Right election.

7. Community
The biggest heists and a daily recap posted to the Chog Telegram and Discord, with Discord roles that match your gang in the game.

The long-term goal: a Chog's reputation in the city should be worth something, and it should go wherever the Chog goes.
judge_access:
No wallet needed to try it.

1. Open https://grandtheftchog.duckdns.org on a phone or computer. Move by dragging (phone) or with the arrow keys (computer).
2. Follow the gold arrow to the Practice warehouse and press Use (E on a computer). It's a full robbery with no real cash:
   - The lock: do what the screen says (tap when the pin is in the gold band, cut the wires in the order shown, stop the reels on the gang's building, or turn the dial to each number). Slip more than once and the alarm goes off.
   - The vault: grab the cash and avoid the guards. You have 3 hearts and each touch costs one. For the big prize, stand next to the safe and press Use (Space on a computer), then press again each time the spinning needle is in the green, twice. Your Chog's powers are on Q and E (buttons on a phone). Leave through EXIT before time runs out.
   - The run home: follow the gold arrow to your gang's door before the police catch you.

Have a Chog? Tap "Play as your Chog" and type the wallet address that holds it. No connecting, no signing. To rob for real, send yourself a tiny amount of MON (it comes straight back) to prove the wallet is yours, pick your gang, then walk to a rival gang's door and press Rob.

Watch a real robbery: https://grandtheftchog.duckdns.org/recap
